newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House Speaker Gingrich calls for tax review.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House Speaker Gingrich calls for tax review.

text.p: Newly re-elected U.S. House Speaker Newt Gingrich called Tuesday for a fundamental review by Congress of the U.S. tax code.

The Georgian Republican told lawmakers he had asked Rep Bill Archer of Texas, chairman of the tax-writing Ways and Means Committee, to hold hearings to study different alternatives, including moving towards a flat tax and replacing the income tax with a sales tax.
"I have ... asked Chairman Archer to prepare a series of hearings looking at the entire issue of how we revise the entire tax code," Gingrich said.
Gingrich said the process would take four to six years.
He also said the new Congress should focus on creating U.S. jobs through exports, and said Archer should look at the issue of taxation in light of how it affects job creation.
